Apple Inc. (AAPL) Holdings Trimmed by SPC Financial Inc. Posted by Dante Gardener | Jan 30th, 2018 
SPC Financial Inc. trimmed its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.4% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 12,898 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 732 shares during the quarter. SPC Financial Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,988,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). 
A number of other hedge funds have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. Pioneer Trust Bank N A OR boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 1.1% in the second quarter. Pioneer Trust Bank N A OR now owns 54,959 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,915,000 after buying an additional 580 shares during the last quarter. Livforsakringsbolaget Skandia Omsesidigt raised its holdings in Apple by 0.4% in the 2nd quarter. Livforsakringsbolaget Skandia Omsesidigt now owns 320,221 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $46,119,000 after purchasing an additional 1,200 shares during the period. Lau Associates LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 11.4% in the 2nd quarter. Lau Associates LLC now owns 62,324 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,976,000 after purchasing an additional 6,372 shares during the period. Xact Kapitalforvaltning AB raised its holdings in Apple by 2.2% in the 2nd quarter. Xact Kapitalforvaltning AB now owns 889,513 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $128,108,000 after purchasing an additional 19,469 shares during the period. Finally, Centre Asset Management LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 2.5% in the 2nd quarter. Centre Asset Management LLC now owns 155,878 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $22,450,000 after purchasing an additional 3,870 shares during the period. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 60.26% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
A number of equities analysts recently weighed in on AAPL shares. Macquarie set a $188.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday. ValuEngine raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Sunday, December 31st. Zacks Investment Research upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 price target for the company in a research report on Thursday, January 18th. Piper Jaffray Companies restated a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, January 2nd. Finally, Bank of America lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and upped their price target for the company from $180.00 to $220.00 in a research report on Wednesday, January 17th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, thirteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-six have assigned a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $201.12. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, November 14th. The shares were sold at an average price of $172.35, for a total transaction of $2,695,726.35. Following the sale, the insider now owns 39,682 shares in the company, valued at $6,839,192.70. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available through this hyperlink . Also, SVP Johny Srouji sold 5,760 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, November 22nd. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.40, for a total transaction of $1,004,544.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now owns 81,560 shares in the company, valued at approximately $14,224,064. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last 90 days, insiders sold 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155. Company insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $167.96 on Tuesday. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $120.62 and a 12-month high of $180.10. The firm has a market cap of $862,360.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.28, a P/E/G ratio of 1.39 and a beta of 1.23. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $1.87 by $0.20. The firm had revenue of $52.58 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $50.71 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The firm’s revenue was up 12.2% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the company earned $1.50 EPS. analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.17 earnings per share for the current year.
